scope: Read all 32 authored resources, checked worked examples and internal consistency, and compared cited sources with their limited stated purpose. Recorded final generated download hashes.
limitations: No independent practitioner review or professional credentials.
No project-specific engineering, legal, regulatory, purchasing or installation approval.
Hash recording does not by itself prove compatibility in every native editor; consult the separate artifact QA evidence.
No invented clients, testimonials, owners, permissions or business outcomes.

resources.finding: Corrected the What works today example, which had mixed a desired future functional goal into present conditions. Retained elements are now stated separately and current household experience remains unconfirmed. Checked eight discovery fields, private data handling and unresolved needs.

Corrected Retained conditions: the example had repeated a functional goal from the general constraints list. It now names only the existing floor, window and entrance, with verification still required. Functional priorities remain a separate field.
Checked scope, phases, fees and approval language. No invented fee, delivery date, client approval or executable contract is supplied; the proposal remains an educational outline.
Checked deliverables against exclusions and responsibility interfaces. Unappointed parties remain unassigned, and the sample does not imply construction-ready output or legal authority.

Recomputed worked figures: 1300 and 550, known subtotal 1850, allowance 2000 and remainder 150 USD. FIN-02 remains unresolved. Blank additional costs contributing zero do not establish completeness or a final quote.

Checked stable F-01/J-01 identifiers, product-source fields and missing model/dimension evidence. Nominal joinery values do not become fabrication data. Houzz supports field structure only; its classification and commercial claims are not adopted wholesale.

Checked one sofa, one chair and one rug against the sample references. Built-in joinery and retained flooring are explicitly outside this library's FF&E convention; selected and ordered remain distinct.
Checked FIN-01/FIN-02 surface assignments. The 20 square metre nominal floor footprint is not wall area or a purchase quantity; product coverage, waste and wall area remain unresolved.
Checked 5000 by 4000 by 2800 mm nominal values, units, source labels and opening unknowns. The room record does not imply a completed site survey or substitute estimated dimensions.
Checked phase dependencies, review decisions and owner/date fields. No invented start, finish, supplier commitment or completed project state is introduced; this is a manual planning workbook.

Checked access, permission, units, reference points, photo register and inaccessible conditions. No real visit or concealed-service assessment is represented. Leica supports the limited diagonal-check explanation, not a safety or accuracy guarantee.
